title: Lehi tells Nephi of the command
summary: Lehi tells Nephi that the Lord commanded in a dream that Nephi and his brothers return to Jerusalem, go to Laban’s house to seek the records, and bring them to the wilderness. He explains that Laban has the record of the Jews and a genealogy of Lehi’s forefathers engraved on brass plates.

Lehi said Laban had the record of the Jews and a genealogy of Lehi’s forefathers engraved on brass plates.
Lehi said the Lord commanded Nephi and his brothers to go to Laban’s house, seek the records, and bring them to the wilderness.

title: Nephi persuades his brothers to continue
summary: Nephi urges his brothers not to return to their father until they accomplish the Lord’s command. He explains why they should obtain the records, and his words persuade them to keep God’s commandments.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi declares they will not go down to their father in the wilderness until they accomplish the thing the Lord commanded.
Nephi urges faithfulness and proposes going to the land of their father’s inheritance, where their father left gold, silver, and other riches.
Nephi says his father knew Jerusalem must be destroyed because of the people’s wickedness and rejection of the prophets, and that his father would perish if he stayed after being commanded to flee.
Nephi says obtaining the records will preserve their fathers’ language and the words of the holy prophets for their children.
Nephi’s words persuade his brothers to be faithful in keeping God’s commandments.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi addresses his brothers while explaining why they should continue their undertaking.
unspecified_visual_details: The setting and the brothers’ individual identities are not specified in these verses.
The father’s flight, Jerusalem’s future destruction, and the ancient prophets are discussed but are not described as occurring in the present scene.

spoken_dialogue.text: As the Lord liveth, and as we live, we will not go down unto our father in the wilderness until we have accomplished the thing which the Lord hath commanded us.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: Wherefore, let us be faithful in keeping the commandments of the Lord; therefore let us go down to the land of our father’s inheritance, for behold he left gold and silver, and all manner of riches.

spoken_dialogue.text: For he knew that Jerusalem must be destroyed, because of the wickedness of the people.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: For behold, they have rejected the words of the prophets.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: And behold, it is wisdom in God that we should obtain these records, that we may preserve unto our children the language of our fathers;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: And also that we may preserve unto them the words which have been spoken by the mouth of all the holy prophets, which have been delivered unto them by the Spirit and power of God, since the world began, even down unto this present time.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

narration.text: And it came to pass that after this manner of language did I persuade my brethren, that they might be faithful in keeping the commandments of God.
